verdict.rationale: Stable's docs say you can configure webhook endpoints in the Dashboard to receive notifications about account events. Onboarding progress can be monitored via webhooks, and the pricing page lists "API and webhooks" as a plan feature. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and payload schemas, signature verification and retry semantics, programmatic (API-based) endpoint registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can configure webhook endpoints via the Stable Dashboard. We use webhooks to notify you about important events that happen with your account.
Monitor the onboarding progress via webhooks
